Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Medusa character master illustration for a premium Greek mythology slot game, transparent isolated full-body, portrait 1:2 composition. Reference Image 1 is the user's approved game's art style, colors and character direction; follow it closely while creating a new ORIGINAL drawing.
Primary request: ONE finished full-body adult Medusa snake-tail queen, three-quarter view facing LEFT toward the reels, readable funny confident acting, elegant gold cat-eye sunglasses worn normally over complete eyes. The head FACE alone is flat cel cartoon yellow #FFD83A, one pale shadow, confident asymmetrical smirk with red lipstick, wide oval expressive eyes, long lashes and teal eyeliner, small round nose, no realistic facial highlights. Original face, not any established cartoon character. The neck, shoulders, arms and hands are SAME golden yellow with soft dimensional lighting. Blend under the outlined jaw naturally.
Her snake hair, armor, jewelry and huge coiled snake tail are lush glossy semi-realistic hand-painted premium slot art, the same polished dimensionality as reference. Wide asymmetrical teal serpent hair, 9 clearly readable front serpents with separate curving necks and amber slit eyes, five open mouths and four closed mouths, plus darker rear hair mass. No tall hair tower. Narrow original gold circlet with blue teardrop stone; gold collar. FULLY COVERING modest ornate teal/navy breastplate with gold edging, original geometric curling ornament, blue gems; golden bracers, crossed waist bands, separate hanging gold chains, three teal/gold skirt armor panels. Belt buckle is a subtle snake-eye motif, no skull.
Below waist: ONE thick luminous teal snake tail with pale belly scutes, coiled into a broad grounded loop, tip visible lower right; absolutely no human legs or feet. Adult elongated body, head approximately 1:4.5, hair broad. Both arms angle gently outward, elbows slightly bent, each palm down and FIVE clearly separated fingers with gold nails, at least 50px clear air between arm/hand and torso. Front arm is on screen LEFT, its wrist accessible for future sunglasses pulling animation; arms stay below shoulders in this neutral master. Hands do not overlap hair, chest or tail. Pose planted and graceful, not rigid T pose.
Composition: whole figure including all hair tips, finger tips and entire coiled tail within frame, 7 percent transparent margin, centered, no shadow plate, no floor, no props, no lettering, no border, no glow effects. Upper-left warm light, careful metallic highlights, fine dark outlines on body, bold clean outlines on face only. Sculptural rich teal scales and thick mirror-gold armor, round forms, professional finished illustrator quality. Preserve true clean alpha transparency. This must feel like the approved reference's character elevated into a clean full-body production painting.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input Image 1 is the approved Medusa master, sole edit target. Create the production TORSO layer only, true transparent background, with original costume, colors, lighting and 3/4 LEFT facing perspective locked. Remove the entire head, crown, glasses, all hair, both arms and hands, skirt panels, hanging waist chains and entire tail. Retain the yellow neck from below jaw, shoulder sockets, gold collar and sapphire, fully covering blue/gold chest armor, the waist skin and crossed black waist bands, complete gold belt with original snake-eye buckle. Paint fully complete shoulders and side ribs where arms/hair obscured them, natural rounded yellow shoulder joints to animate arms over. This is ONE isolated intact torso from neckline to bottom of belt, no other parts. Keep proportions and identity precisely from the master; no anatomy redesign, no extra jewelry, no text, no floor or glow. Same glossy professional rendering as master. Place enlarged to fill 80 percent of a portrait canvas with 8 percent clear transparent margins.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input Image 1 is the Medusa master, sole edit target. Extract and finish ONLY her complete coiled TEAL SNAKE TAIL, exactly the tail design from the image, on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Remove the human upper body, arms, hands, face, hair, ALL gold/blue skirt armor, ALL chains and belt. Restore the concealed upper tail underneath the skirt armor as fully painted teal scales, with a rounded hidden joining stump at top center. Preserve the broad planted coil, pale aqua belly scutes, left foreground curve, loop returning behind on right, and curled tip at upper right. This is one continuous organically connected tail from waist joint to tip, original glossy painterly scales, upper-left highlights, dimensional anatomy, no legs. Whole tail entirely in frame, clean alpha all around, no ground shadow, no other pieces, no lettering. Front view matches master's 3/4-left perspective. Use a square canvas with 8 percent transparent margin.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input Image 1 is the Medusa master, sole edit target. Make ONLY her HEAD AND NARROW GOLD CIRCLET as a production animation layer, facing 3/4 LEFT. Remove all snake hair and all sunglasses completely, remove the neck below jaw and every armor/body element. Restore full forehead, temples and ears that were under snakes and glasses, complete clear eyes. The face MUST be truly flat cel cartoon #FFD83A with only ONE pale yellow shadow #E3B520, bold clean dark outline #2A1F24, absolutely no realistic facial gradient, no cheek or nose highlights. Preserve original identity, elongated oval face with asymmetric confident red-lip smirk, wide expressive oval eyes looking LEFT, teal eyeshadow, long eyelashes, small round nose. The crown remains glossy gold with a blue waterdrop gem, same crown design. No other snakes, jewelry or parts. One isolated head from circlet top to chin, no neck, identical natural jaw edge for swapping expressions. On a square TRUE TRANSPARENT canvas, centered, fill 80%, no caption or text. This is the same woman, not a new character.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is the Medusa master, sole source of identity and costume. Production animation ART SHEET of only TWO separate complete arms from the master, on true transparent alpha, no body, no face, no hair. Left half: her screen-left/front arm from rounded shoulder cap through elbow to open hand, SAME downward-left relaxed bent pose, intact gold bicep ring, blue/gold bracer and FIVE clearly separated long yellow fingers with gold nails. Right half: her screen-right/back arm from rounded shoulder cap to open hand, downward-right relaxed bent pose, same FIVE fingers. Both arms include complete restored round shoulder joint caps and wrist skin, no holes at joints, beautifully finished soft two-step golden-yellow skin, sculptural mirror-gold and sapphire armor. Upper-left light. Each complete arm is separate, entirely within its own half, straight readable anatomy, 12% empty margin between and around them. No duplicated torso, no extra limbs, no text. IMPORTANT: absolutely no external glows, no atmospheric halo or cast shadow beyond silhouette; only clean antialiased alpha around physical arms.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is the Medusa master. Production animation rear HAIR MASS layer only. Render her wide, asymmetrical dark teal coiled serpent-hair mass as glossy intertwining thick teal scaled coils, with the exact head-facing-LEFT overall shape from reference. Remove the face, crown, neck, shoulders, body, sunglasses and ALL VISIBLE SNAKE HEADS and mouths. No snake faces or eyes anywhere: all foreground snake heads/necks are separate future layers. A dark inward recess in the center behind where the face belongs is okay, but restore complete coiled hair under it as dark teal loops, not black filled background. This should resemble a full wide lush mane of snakes with a central face opening. Curves spread broadly left/right, not vertically piled. True transparent alpha, one isolated wig-like rear hair silhouette, no lettering, no glow, no atmospheric halo or shadow outside silhouette. Master's premium glossy teal scale rendering and upper-left light, not flat vector art. Centered square composition with 8% transparent margins.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is the Medusa master, sole source of costume. Create a PRODUCTION ARMOR PARTS SHEET with five separate isolated objects on a true transparent background: top row three individual matching skirt armor plates (left hip plate, long central front plate, right hip plate), glossy deep teal/navy enamel with thick mirror gold edges and blue gems, original master's shapes and ornaments. Bottom row two separate hanging golden waist-chain loops, a shorter and a longer, delicately linked but chunky enough to read at 200px character height. No belt, no torso, no tail, no skin, no hair. Three plates evenly separated across upper two-thirds of canvas, two chain loops side-by-side in lower third, no objects touch; generous transparent gap and full margins. Keep same 3/4-left design and upper-left light. No text, no numbering, no background, no external glow/shadow; only crisp finished painted metal shapes with clean antialiased alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation SPRITE SHEET on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. Reference Image 1 is our ORIGINAL Medusa master; use EXACTLY its glossy teal scaled snake design, amber vertical slit eyes, red inner mouths and small ivory fangs. Draw NINE SEPARATE COMPLETE SERPENTS, arranged in a precise 3x3 grid with generous empty gutters. Each cell contains ONE snake head attached to its own long curving S-shaped thick neck, ending in a rounded hidden joining stump at bottom. Each snake entirely fits in its own cell, no snakes touch or overlap, no hair mass or human. All necks generally vertical so each will later be independently rigged. Natural varied S and reverse-S curves, head at upper quarter; some face left, some right, some nearly front. First five snakes in reading order have mouths open and fangs visible; last four have mouths closed, two with a short tongue. Same species, varied poses, same coherent upper-left light and chunky sculptural silhouette. Three large-neck shapes in top row, four medium in middle and lower-left, two smaller in lower-middle/right; consistent native cell scale is okay since art is resized when rigging. Each has a 15% transparent cell margin. Very clear continuous body/head joins and fully painted necks. No labels, numbers, text, frames, background, floor or glow. High-fidelity professionally finished painted slot art, not flat line icons. This single sheet is an animation component atlas, not a scene.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is our original Medusa master. Extract and finish ONLY HER GOLD CAT-EYE SUNGLASSES as one clean isolated production sprite, 3/4 LEFT-facing perspective identical to master. Two deep #1A1420 lenses with one elegant white reflection each, thick polished gold cat-eye rim and bridge, right temple arm visible, left temple in perspective. Keep same silhouette and lens sizes as master's glasses; do not include eyes, skin, hair, crown, hand, face or nose. ONE pair only, horizontal centered composition, ample clear transparent margin, true alpha background. No other object, no letters, no glow, no cast shadow outside physical glasses. Lush hand-painted mirror gold, professional finish.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is our Medusa master. Production HAND-GESTURE sprite sheet, true transparent background, three isolated screen-left/front hands arranged horizontally in three equal separated cells. All are the SAME golden-yellow elegant adult woman's hand, same wrist skin and gold nails, same 3/4-left palm perspective as the master's front arm; neutral wrist cutoff is identical. Left cell: open palm downward, five separated fingers. Middle cell: index extended pointing LEFT, other three fingers curled with thumb visible. Right cell: thumb and index finger pinching a tiny empty space for holding the sunglasses rim, other three fingers curled clearly; exactly FIVE fingers total. Do not draw glasses, bracelet, forearm, arm or anything held; end every hand with a rounded wrist stub fully drawn for hidden overlap under her bracer. Upper-left light and two soft yellow shadow tones, master’s dimensional hands, fine dark outline, no body, no face. Hands entirely within their own cell, large clean transparent gutters, no text, numbers, grid lines, atmospheric glow, or shadows outside silhouette. Professional final illustrated anatomy, not mannequin symbols.

Edit ONLY the attached head sprite. REMOVE EVERY SINGLE STRAND AND CURL OF TEAL HUMAN HAIR. This character is Medusa and all snake hair will be separate animation parts later, so this layer MUST BE COMPLETELY BALD: a smooth round yellow scalp, temples and ears, gold crown, face and jaw only. Absolutely NO human hair, teal curls, snakes, neck, glasses or body. Reconstruct yellow forehead/scalp behind the existing crown cleanly. Preserve this exact woman's 3/4 LEFT-facing face silhouette, eye and mouth placement, smile, circlet and gem. Flatten face rendering to flat cel-cartoon #FFD83A and one pale shadow only, no glossy cheek, nose or lip highlights. Crown may retain glossy gold. Portrait head only fills 80% of square frame. Same scale, camera and expression. TRUE transparent alpha outside the physical bald head, no halo, no shadow, no lettering.

Edit ONLY the attached torso production cutout. Remove the ENTIRE hazy yellow/gold glow and dark atmosphere around the figure. Everything OUTSIDE THE PHYSICAL TORSO OUTLINE must be 100% TRANSPARENT alpha=0. Preserve original physical torso pixels: same yellow skin, marble-smooth shoulders, collar, blue/gold breastplate, straps, waist, belt, original pose and dimensions. Keep antialiased physical edges, no shadow behind or around the cutout. A clean transparent product cutout, not a black/dark background with a glow. Do not add arms, head, hair, tail or new ornaments. Same centered portrait canvas and scale.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is the exact BALD HEAD model of our original Medusa. Create ONE 3-column by 2-row animation EXPRESSION ATLAS on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. SIX equal cells, same character and camera, NO HAIR, NO SNAKES, NO GLASSES, NO NECK, no extra accessories. In every cell lock the exact SAME bald head silhouette, gold circlet/sapphire design and position, ear and jaw outline, same 3/4 LEFT-facing perspective and size. Only eyelids, eyebrows, pupils and mouth/lips change. Flat yellow #FFD83A face, bold clean outline, teal eyeliner, red lips; keep crown glossy gold. NO realistic skin shading. Reading order: top-left neutral confident asymmetric closed-mouth smile; top-middle smug one eyebrow raised with slightly pursed red lips; top-right peeking stern gaze, lowered eyebrows, large oval eyes looking LEFT; bottom-left powerful gaze with AMBER eye whites and thin lime vertical slit pupils, mouth firm; bottom-middle annoyed eye-roll upward and mouth pulled sideways; bottom-right shocked wide eyes and open O mouth. All six COMPLETE BALD heads fit fully within their own equal cells with 12% transparent gutter margins. Facial identity and outline must remain identical across all cells. No text, numbers, dividers, labels or extra props. This is a clean reusable sprite atlas, not a character lineup scene.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference Image 1 is the exact BALD HEAD model of our original Medusa. Create ONE 2-column by 2-row animation EXPRESSION ATLAS on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. FOUR equal cells, exact same face identity and 3/4 LEFT-facing camera. Every cell: same bald head silhouette, same glossy GOLD CIRCLET with blue sapphire, ears and jaw outline, same scale and alignment. NO HAIR, NO SNAKES, NO GLASSES, NO NECK. Flat yellow #FFD83A face with one pale cel shadow, bold dark outline, teal eyeliner and red lips. Only facial features change. Top-left: exuberant big LAUGH, eyes squinting into crescents, open red-lipped mouth showing upper teeth. Top-right: crying-happy laughter, eyebrows lifted, crescent eyes with tiny blue tears at corners only (no long tear streams), wide delighted grin. Bottom-left: gentle BLINK, eyes fully closed with lashes down, neutral asymmetric closed-mouth smile. Bottom-right: TALK, eyes open looking LEFT, lips half-open as if speaking. All four complete heads fit fully in equal cells with 12% clear transparent margins, consistent crown position. No text, numbers, cell frames, labels, background, glows or extras. Facial outline stays fixed to the model for animation swapping.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI architecture asset for the Medusa slot in Reference 1. ONE sculptural ivory marble IONIC VOLUTE CAPITAL CORNER ornament, carved soft spiral, chunky glossy premium hand-painted marble with restrained thin mirror gold trim and warm shadow underneath. Straight-on front view with slight top light, no perspective tilt. Quarter circular square corner 1:1 silhouette, fill 82 percent of square canvas, generous transparent margins. It attaches at the upper-left of a square 6x6 reel frame, so solid marble spine extends to the right and down, spiral front face round and readable. Match the approved game's marble architecture EXACTLY in polish and palette; upper-left light. NO letters, NO UI numbers, NO gems, NO snakes, NO extra panels, NO background, true transparent alpha. Professional final art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular game reel FRAME HORIZONTAL LINTEL texture. Reference 1 is the approved game's style. ONE perfectly front-facing long horizontal ivory marble beam, body aspect 4:1, thin polished mirror gold rails along top and bottom, subtle restrained warm marble veining, shallow bevels, sculptural crisp artisan-painted edges with upper-left light. Both left and right ends are FLAT open continuation cuts, no end caps, no text, no ornament, no jewels or characters. Designed to tile/extend horizontally between separate Ionic corner capitals. Object centered on wide transparent canvas with 15 percent empty space above and below, only one beam. Match reference's premium glossy slot-art material. No backdrop, no shadow plate, TRUE alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular game reel FRAME VERTICAL COLUMN SHAFT texture. Reference 1 is the approved game style. ONE straight vertical fluted ivory marble column shaft, front view, narrow rectangular object aspect1:4, thin mirror-gold edge at each side, quiet cream marble with 3 broad rounded flutes and restrained marbling, upper-left highlight and soft right shade, premium glossy painted slot art. Top and bottom end FLAT open continuation cuts with no capitals or bases. Designed to extend vertically between separate Ionic capitals. Centered on portrait transparent canvas, 15 percent transparent side margins. No letters, no characters, no jewels or ornaments, no floor, no background. TRUE transparent alpha. Exact same marble and gold material as reference.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production GAME BUTTON STATES atlas, true transparent alpha. Reference 1 is the approved Medusa game's premium marble/gold style. TWO perfectly circular round button discs side by side at IDENTICAL size, aligned centers, separated by generous transparent gutter. Left: polished IVORY marble face inset within a thick rounded antique gold ring, shallow recessed center completely blank, fine warm marble texture. Right: same exact geometry and inset face, but rich mirror GOLD face/rim for active state, quiet amber center. Directly front-facing, upper-left light, chunky sculptural bevels and dark teal thin lower-edge shadow. NO ICONS, arrows, letters, numbers, portraits, snakes, stars or glows. No external shadows, no backdrop. Each disc fills 80 percent of its own square half. Finished artisan-painted UI, visually matches approved reel-frame material.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production BUY BONUS SHIELD UI plate for the game. Reference Image 1 is our original Medusa character and palette. A large chunky rounded Greek Aegis SHIELD silhouette on true transparent alpha, nearly square with tapered rounded bottom point, thick mirror gold sculptural rim and ivory marble inlay. In the UPPER HALF only, a polished embossed cameo of our yellow-faced Medusa in golden cat-eye sunglasses and teal snake hair, same character identity as reference, bold readable fun relief. LOWER 40 PERCENT is a completely BLANK flat ivory plaque area for the game to typeset a short label, no internal second border or separate baseboard. The upper cameo and lower text space are part of ONE continuous shield. Premium glossy painting with left-top light, gold/teal/marble palette, no gloom, no external halo or glow. Shield occupies 86% of square canvas with true transparent margin all around. No typography, no lettering, no logo, no text, no additional objects or mounting panel.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production FREE-GAME MULTIPLIER PLAQUE STATES atlas on true transparent alpha. Reference Image1 is our original Medusa. THREE IDENTICAL horizontal plaques stacked vertically in three separate equal rows, same geometry, scale and alignment, each object aspect approximately 2:1 with ample clear gutters. ONE continuous rounded gold frame around each plaque; LEFT THIRD has a small round inset cameo of our Medusa's yellow cartoon face, teal snake hair, gold cat-eye sunglasses. RIGHT TWO THIRDS is a single completely blank very dark teal #123840 inset field for large multiplier numbers; keep it calm and unobstructed. No actual text/numerals anywhere. Top row: restrained polished gold frame. Middle row: brighter rich gold rails and a few tiny blue jewel insets at corners. Bottom row: highest level richer mirror gold and diamond-like blue corner accents, same footprint, no glow beyond silhouette. Sculptural glossy professional slot UI, upper-left light, no separate stacked boards, no snakes poking into the number field, no labels or dividers between rows. Background is true transparent alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production blank FREE SPINS stone-scroll UI panel for the approved Medusa game (Reference 1). Perfectly front-facing wide rounded RECTANGULAR ivory marble tablet, aspect1.85:1, thin richly sculpted gold rim and two restrained short rolled marble volutes at the far left and far right sides. ONE single uninterrupted flat ivory inner surface fills 80% of area, for a title, large count and small caption that will be typeset by the program. No second title plate, no overlaid small board. Clean warm luminous marble, restrained natural veining, quiet light center for dark/gold text, mirror gold edges and soft bevels. Thick playful rounded sculptural forms, premium illustrated slot art with upper-left light. No text, no numbers, no Medusa or other characters, no dangling ornaments, no glow or background shadow. Entire panel fits with true transparent margin around all sides, no backdrop.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production bottom BET TOOLBAR STRIP for a premium Greek Medusa slot (reference 1). A very long extremely low horizontal continuous panel, physical object aspect8:1, dark polished TEAL stone face #173A40 with subtle calm material, thin bevelled ivory marble and mirror-gold rails above and below, softly rounded end caps. Completely blank across its entire interior: no separators, no buttons, no icons, no numbers, no lettering. It must be a single slim elegant strip that will sit along the bottom of a game screen behind live text and separate round buttons. Professional hand-painted sculptural marble/gold material, upper-left light. Center the long narrow strip across the middle of a wide TRUE TRANSPARENT canvas, ample empty transparent space above/below. No external glow, no background, no floor shadow, no extra panels or decorations.

Use case: logo-brand. ONE original title WORDMARK for our Greek Medusa slot, true transparent background. Text verbatim: "MEDUSA GAZE". Spell exactly M E D U S A and G A Z E. Two centered lines: MEDUSA large on top, GAZE slightly smaller underneath. Custom crafted playful monumental Greek lettering, chunky softly rounded carved letterforms with rich polished GOLD bevel edges and deep saturated teal/enamel faces, tiny subtle serpent curves integrated in the S strokes, premium painted slot title. Strong readable dark outline and restrained short shadow contained close to letters, upper-left highlight, coherent with the approved reference art. The wordmark is LETTERING ONLY, no plaque, no frame, no stone block, no portrait, no giant snake, no scene or ornament outside the letter silhouette. Wide overall composition aspect 2.7:1 centered on landscape transparent canvas, whole lettering has 10% clear margin. Do not imitate any existing cartoon or movie title typography. High-end original game branding, clear at 200px wide.
